data.name: Diana
data.message: Doing my scan, want to buddy up?

I just came from weapons into cafeteria and found Alice's body right here in cafeteria. I didn't see anyone on my way — went weapons to cafeteria, that's it. Whoever killed her must have left just before I arrived, or slipped out through electrical or storage. I didn't see anyone leaving though. Curious to hear where everyone else was.

I was upper engine to oxygen, then crossed through cafeteria. I saw Alice alive in cafeteria around then, no body when I passed. After that I went down toward medbay and Diana was there with me when the report happened. I didn’t see Charlie at all.

If Alice is dead in cafeteria, it had to be pretty shortly after I left. Paths out would be electrical/medbay side or maybe storage. Not hard accusing Charlie, but a cafeteria self-report is possible too, depending on timing.

I don't have much to offer unfortunately — I've been in security the whole round trying to get to my CheckCamera task, didn't see anyone come through. So I can't confirm or deny anyone's movements.

What I can say: Bob's story places him passing through cafeteria and seeing Alice alive, then heading to medbay with Diana. If Diana confirms being with Bob at medbay, that's a solid alibi for both of them. That would leave Charlie and Frank as the main suspects, with Charlie being the reporter from cafeteria.

I want to hear from Diana and Frank before deciding. Diana, please confirm whether you were with Bob. Frank, where were you?

I can confirm Bob's story. I came from electrical into medbay, and Bob entered medbay from cafeteria at the same tick — I literally saw him come in from the cafeteria side. So Bob and I are each other's alibis at medbay when the report happened.

That matches Bob's account of crossing through cafeteria and heading to medbay. If he had just killed Alice in cafeteria, he wouldn't have casually walked into medbay right in front of me — and the timing of Charlie's report came right after.

That leaves Charlie and Frank as the real suspects. Charlie self-reporting from cafeteria is suspicious, especially since Bob says Alice was alive when he passed through moments before. But I want to hear Frank before locking in. Frank, where were you?

I've been in storage the entire round working on Sort Cargo — didn't see anyone come through, didn't see anyone leave. I came in from the medbay/storage corridor side and stayed put.

So here's what we have: Bob and Diana alibi each other in medbay. I was alone in storage, but storage connects to cafeteria — meaning if I were the killer, I'd have had a clear path. That said, I didn't see anyone pass through storage either direction, which actually matters: if the killer fled cafeteria through storage, I would have seen them. Nobody came.

That leaves the killer exiting cafeteria via electrical, or… staying in cafeteria. Eve says she was in security the whole time, which is adjacent to electrical — she'd likely have seen someone bolt through. And Charlie claims he entered cafeteria from weapons and immediately found the body.

Charlie's self-report from the murder room, with Bob having just seen Alice alive there, is the most suspicious thread. Bob and Diana confirm each other, I can confirm nobody fled through storage, and Eve was camped by electrical's exit. Charlie's the odd one out.

I'm voting Charlie.

Wait, I'm being asked to speak again? I already gave my report first. But fine, let me respond to Frank's accusation directly since the others have spoken.

Look — I AM the reporter, and yes, self-reports look suspicious, but think about it logically. If I killed Alice, why would I immediately call a meeting on myself with zero alibi prepared? I'd have walked away and let someone else find her.

Frank's logic actually has a hole. He says nobody fled through storage — but he's alone there with no one to confirm he was even IN storage the whole time. Storage connects directly to cafeteria. He could have killed Alice and walked back to storage in seconds. His "alibi" is self-reported, same as he's accusing me of.

Bob and Diana genuinely alibi each other. Eve was in security. That leaves me and Frank — and between the two of us, Frank has an unverified solo location adjacent to the crime scene, while I came from weapons which is also adjacent but further.

I'm not voting Frank blindly, but I want everyone to seriously consider him before piling on me. Don't let a confident speech railroad the vote.

I’m still leaning Charlie here. I get that “why would I self-report” is a fair argument, but self-reports happen exactly to control the timing and story before anyone else walks in.

My key point is timing: I saw Alice alive in cafeteria, then I left toward medbay, and Diana confirms I arrived there from cafeteria side right as she came in. The report happened basically right after. So whoever killed Alice had to be in or entering cafeteria immediately after I left.

Frank is unconfirmed, sure, and storage is adjacent, so I’m not saying he’s impossible. But if he was in storage, that route should’ve had movement, and he says nobody came through. Eve says she was security, which makes electrical side less likely too. Charlie is the one who says he came directly into the body from weapons, with no one else seen.

So for me it’s between Charlie and Frank, but Charlie being on the body with that tight timing is the strongest suspicion. I’m voting Charlie unless someone has new info.

Given what we've heard, I'm leaning Charlie too. Bob and Diana solidly alibi each other in medbay. Frank's in storage is unverified, but he makes a fair point — if the killer fled through storage, he'd have seen them, and nobody did. I was in security the whole time and saw nobody pass through toward electrical either.

So the killer either came from weapons (Charlie) or stayed in cafeteria. Charlie arriving from weapons and immediately finding the body right after Bob saw Alice alive there is the tightest timing match. The weapons-to-cafeteria path lines up perfectly with the kill window.

Charlie's counter on Frank isn't bad in isolation, but Frank's storage claim is at least falsifiable by movement patterns, and nothing contradicts it. Charlie's is the one location we can't rule out as the murder spot itself.

I'm voting Charlie.

I'll keep this short since I already spoke earlier and the case has crystallized.

Everything Bob, Eve, and Frank just said lines up with what I saw. Bob came into medbay from the cafeteria side right as I entered from electrical — that's locked. Frank's storage claim is consistent with nobody being seen fleeing that way, and Eve covers the electrical/security side.

That leaves Charlie's weapons-to-cafeteria entry as the tightest timing match for the kill. His "why would I self-report" defense is the standard one, but controlling the narrative by reporting first is exactly what a Duck does when they know someone might walk in. And his pivot to accusing Frank feels like deflection — Frank's storage alibi is at least consistent with movement patterns, while Charlie was literally on the body.

I'm voting Charlie.

Nothing much to add beyond what I already said. The room agrees: Bob and Diana alibi each other, Eve was in security, I was in storage and saw no one come through. That leaves Charlie arriving from weapons right as Alice died in cafeteria — tightest timing, on the body, and his only defense is deflecting onto me.

Locking it in. Voting Charlie.

data.name: Frank
data.message: Heading to weapons to clear asteroids, see you Diana

I found Eve's body in navigation. I just arrived there from storage. My route this round was electrical, then medbay where I saw Bob early on and Frank around tick 11, then upper engine, oxygen, back through upper engine to lower engine where I saw Frank again at ticks 23 and 24. Frank then left lower engine heading to upper engine at tick 25, and I went down to storage and then navigation, where I found Eve dead.

So Frank was nowhere near navigation when I last saw him — he went toward upper engine. That said, it's just me and Bob and Frank left alive. Bob, I haven't seen you since tick 6 in medbay. Where have you been? Whoever wasn't accounted for near navigation is our Duck.

Thanks Diana. Let me lay out my route: I started in medbay, went to electrical, back to medbay, then down to storage, then lower engine, then upper engine, then oxygen, and finally cafeteria where the meeting was called.

I can confirm Diana's story — I saw her in lower engine at ticks 23, 24, and 25. She came in from upper engine at tick 23, which matches what she said. And I remember her leaving medbay toward upper engine around tick 11, which also matches.

So Diana and I have been crossing paths and our stories line up. Critically, neither of us went to navigation — Diana only got there at the end when she found Eve's body, and I was nowhere near it.

Bob, you've been a ghost this whole round. Diana hasn't seen you since tick 6, and I haven't seen you at all. Navigation is on the far east side, and with Alice, Charlie, and Eve all dead, it's down to the three of us. Diana and I can vouch for each other's general movements. Bob, you need to account for yourself right now, because from where I'm sitting you're the only one unaccounted for near the crime scene.

I'm voting Bob unless he gives a really convincing route.

I’m not a ghost, I was just mostly on the east side early and then looping back through medbay/caf. My route was storage → navigation early, then back storage → lower engine → upper engine → medbay → electrical → security → weapons → cafeteria, then I looped medbay/electrical/medbay and was back around cafeteria when the report happened.

Important: I saw Eve alive in navigation around tick 11. I did not stay there — I left back through storage and engines. If Eve’s body was found at the end, that’s a long time after I was there.

Diana is the one who actually ended in navigation and reported it. Frank, you’re saying you and Diana crossed in lower engine around 23-25, but after that she says she went storage → navigation alone. That is exactly the path to the body, and nobody can confirm what happened there. This can easily be a self-report.

Frank, I get why I look unaccounted because you didn’t see me, but Diana literally admits she was the last one going into nav. I think the safer vote is Diana here.

Look, I understand why Bob's pointing at me — yes, I was the one who walked into navigation and found the body. But think about the timing. Bob says he saw Eve alive in navigation around tick 11. That's the last confirmed sighting of Eve, and it's from Bob himself. Nobody else can verify Eve was alive after that point.

Frank and I have been crossing paths consistently from tick 11 through tick 25 — medbay, then lower engine. Our stories check out against each other. For me to have killed Eve, I'd have had to do it in the brief window after leaving lower engine at ~25, going through storage, and arriving at navigation. That's possible, sure — but Bob putting himself in navigation with Eve earlier is also very suspicious, and his route is a sprawling loop that conveniently covers everywhere.

Bob, one question: if you were in navigation at tick 11 and Eve was alive, why did Frank never see you in medbay, electrical, or storage on your supposed loop? Frank was in all those rooms.

I'm leaning Bob, but I want to hear if Frank's movements through medbay/electrical line up with Bob's claimed route.

Diana, good question. Let me address it directly.

My route through medbay was: I started there, went to electrical, then BACK to medbay, then down to storage. So I was in medbay roughly tick 1-ish, electrical briefly, medbay again around tick 8-11, then storage. I was in electrical only briefly.

Bob, you claim your route was: storage → navigation early → storage → lower engine → upper engine → medbay → electrical → security → weapons → cafeteria, then looped medbay/electrical/medbay. 

Here's the problem: I was in medbay twice and electrical once. If you genuinely looped through medbay and electrical multiple times, we should have crossed paths at least once. I never saw you. Diana saw you in medbay at tick 6 and then never again. That's a massive gap for someone supposedly looping through the central rooms.

Also, you're the last confirmed person to see Eve alive in navigation. That's the kill location. Your "loop" conveniently covers everywhere but is verified by no one.

Diana and I have mutual confirmation at lower engine ticks 23-25, and her timing for going storage → navigation after that is tight but witnessed by me leaving her there. For her to be the killer, she'd have had to sprint to nav and kill instantly.

I'm voting Bob. His route is unverified and he places himself at the crime scene with the victim.

Frank, you’re acting like “I didn’t see Bob” is proof, but that’s not how movement works. If I’m one room ahead or behind you, we miss each other completely. Diana *herself* says she saw me in medbay early, so I wasn’t just invisible.

The hard fact is this: Diana is the only person who admits going into navigation at the end, alone, and she’s the one who reports. Lower engine → storage → navigation is absolutely enough time after tick 25 to kill and report. That is not “tight,” that is exactly the route to the body.

My seeing Eve alive earlier in nav doesn’t mean I killed her. It means Eve was alive when I left. Nobody has a confirmed sighting of Eve after that because Diana is the one who found her dead.

If you vote me, you’re letting the self-report win. Frank, I think you’re being pocketed here because Diana’s route sounds clean only until the exact moment she goes alone to the body. I’m voting Diana.
